caption:
BJJ, karate, Muay Thai or taekwondo? Momo's kicks go high, but her lower back grumbles after drills.

Kicks, sprawls and throws ask for strength at the end of your hip range, rotation through the mid-back and solid balance on one leg. Being bendy doesn't always mean being in control.

Clinical Pilates can build each of these at a controlled pace: leg circles and side-lying work for the hips, reformer rotation for the mid-back, single-leg work for pivots. Deep groin pain or back pain spreading into the leg is worth a physio assessment first.
